principle: Subtyping lattice + coercion graph for the type system (System 6), over plane_io_contracts' type vocabulary. SUBTYPING: a producer of a SUBTYPE satisfies a consumer of its SUPERTYPE (a jpeg can be used where an image is expected) — this widens what composes for free. COERCION: when two types don't match even by subtyping, a converter COMPONENT can bridge them (html -> markdown) and the compiler auto-inserts it (a compiler pass, like LLVM inserting a cast). Coercion converters are registry components (deterministic where possible). serves_truth=false.
